nodes.label: Megashader Masking Engine
nodes.rationale: One WebGL2 fragment shader evaluates the whole chain of 7 mask kinds plus boolean composition, so any number of layers costs one GPU pass instead of N compositing passes.

nodes.label: Agent Command Registry
nodes.rationale: Every editor capability is a named command so agent chat, verify scripts and keyboard shortcuts all drive the same code path; refcounted beginAgentAction/endAgentAction gives free agent attribution in the change journal.

nodes.label: Collage Engine (pure geometry)
nodes.rationale: Geometry kept React-free so tool UI and agent commands share it; cells use Fabric absolutePositioned clipPaths and Shadow objects so the layout serializes natively with canvas state and cellFromClipPath can recover bounds on reload.

nodes.label: Canvas State Write-Behind Caching
nodes.rationale: Updates batch/debounce in Redis and flush async to Postgres; visibilitychange->hidden uses a normal flush (not beaconUnload) so baseRevision advances and no spurious 'edited on another device' conflict appears.

nodes.label: AI Caching & Deterministic Planning
nodes.rationale: Identical requests keyed by dHash perceptual hash + prompt are cached in Postgres; Gemini runs at fixed seed 42 with a structured responseSchema so a cache hit is a correct answer. JUDGE_VERSION / PLANNER_VERSION must be bumped to invalidate.

nodes.label: Undo/Redo Object Identity Rule
nodes.rationale: loadFromJSON rebuilds every Fabric object, so references go stale — match by src/props, never identity. Never commit a blob: URL: it is page-scoped and revokes on navigation, breaking persistence and undo; upload to ImageKit with a data:-URL fallback.

nodes.label: Per-Capability AI Routing Policy
nodes.rationale: Single source of truth for where each capability runs; resolveOrder() returns preferred-side-first with the other side as runtime fallback so a missing side degrades instead of failing.

nodes.label: RMBG-1.4 Manual Recipe (client matting)
nodes.rationale: AutoModel with model_type:'custom' plus an explicit processor config is the only matting engine that works in this onnxruntime-web build; BiRefNet-lite / MODNet via pipeline() fail, so do not 'simplify' back to them.

nodes.label: Neo-Brutalist 'Void Dark' Theming
nodes.rationale: Pitch-black cards with offset borders and bright colour shadows; brand accent #06B8D4 cyan, void #0B0D12, text #F4F4F5, uppercase monospace.

nodes.label: Brush Latency: contextTop compositing
nodes.rationale: requestRenderAll mid-stroke forces a full scene redraw plus an after:render DOM sync every frame, causing cursor lag; in-stroke feedback therefore goes on Fabric's contextTop, and getCoalescedEvents() keeps high-Hz mice smooth.

nodes.label: Canvas Zoom & Fit Constraints
nodes.rationale: Zoom 5%-300% in 1% increments; 92% safe-zone fit with a reduced 32px padding threshold on small screens.

nodes.label: Local FastAPI AI Selection Service
nodes.rationale: Heavy CV inference is offloaded to a local Python process so it never blocks the Node.js thread; reached via MASK_SERVICE_URL.

nodes.label: In-Browser AI Engines (transformers.js)
nodes.rationale: WebGPU->WASM device fallback, golden-input calibration gate and sticky engine demotion make the client path verifiable rather than works-on-my-machine.

nodes.label: Neon/Postgres + Prisma Backend
nodes.rationale: Prisma models are the source of truth for users, projects, canvas state, revisions, AI caches and telemetry; never bypass the lazy helpers in src/lib/prisma.js.
